summary.headline: ONE sentence — what this change does

walkthrough.text: One sentence about a coherent part of the change (3-6 bullets total)
walkthrough.finding_ref: file:line of the related finding, or empty string

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: One short paragraph — the single issue that decides mergeability, or why nothing blocks the merge
verdict_reasoning.failure_mechanism: One short paragraph — how that issue fails in production; empty string when nothing blocks

file_assessments.overview: One sentence — what changed in this file

checklist.evidence: One sentence — file:line or logic trace

findings.title: Short single-line title (5-8 words, no line breaks)
findings.description: What is wrong and why it matters in production
findings.cause: Root cause — trace the code path
findings.suggested_code: Exact replacement for the flagged line(s) when a mechanical fix applies (one-click GitHub suggestion); else empty string
